//: Typecheck config for the founder-fixture wire harness.
WHY THIS EXISTS: neither of the repo's typecheck gates covers tools/.
tsconfig.build.json includes only src/**/*.ts; the root tsconfig.json includes
src, tests, scripts, *.config.ts and sdk — tools/ appears in NEITHER. Vitest
runs this code through esbuild, which strips types without checking them, so
without this config a type error in the criteria classifiers could not fail
any gate. That is a poor property for the code that decides whether the
product's primary acceptance corpus passed.
Run:  pnpm exec tsc -p tools/founder-fixture-harness/tsconfig.json --noEmit
(also wired as the repo script `fixture:founder:typecheck`).
Scope note: this reaches into src/ only via the detector imports the harness
deliberately makes rather than copying — process-narration,
leading-option-egress-guard, withheld-claim-projection,
unrequested-analysis-confinement, analysis-admission. Those are pulled in
transitively and checked against the real production types, which is the
point: if a producer's vocabulary changes shape, this fails here.
src/**/*.d.ts is included because the ambient module declarations src/ relies
on are otherwise picked up only by tsconfig.build.json's src/**/*.ts glob;
transitively importing a src/ module without them resurfaces settled TS7016s
that are not this tool's to fix.
